title: Provide pluggable API-first portable S3 storage and DynamoDB card catalog
description:
As an application author, I want a pluggable API-first Virtuus persistence boundary, so Kanbus and embedded apps can share portable canonical files with efficient scoped board queries.

First actionable dependency of Kanbus initiative kbs-3df9cc93-530f-4614-98a0-aa175012c1b5. S3 is the cloud source of truth at the same bytes and relative paths as a normal local/EFS Kanbus folder. DynamoDB is a rebuildable card catalog only. Normal reads/writes use the API; the older Git/EFS mirror remains a separate integration. REST is a provisional transport, not a storage contract constraint.

Feature: Portable pluggable persistence
Scenario: Generic CRUD and board retrieval
  Given an authorized tenant/project scope and ordinary issue files
  When an application creates, conditionally updates, deletes, or lists issues through the API
  Then it uses generic issue types, statuses, and scalar custom fields
  And every lookup is restricted to authorized tenant/project scopes
Scenario: Canonical cloud portability
  Given project/issues, project/events, .kanbus.yml, and attachment files
  When a project is copied to or from its S3 namespace
  Then the same relative paths and raw bytes remain readable as a normal Kanbus folder
  And DynamoDB contains only derived cards, pointers, revisions, and hashes
Scenario: Concurrent publication and repair
  Given two writers with the same expected opaque revision
  When one conditional issue write succeeds
  Then the other cannot overwrite it
  And durable supplemental intent allows event/catalog repair after partial failure without claiming cross-object atomicity
Scenario: Rebuild after import
  Given a normal project folder copied into the canonical S3 namespace
  When the catalog is rebuilt from those files
  Then project/type/status board queries return the imported issues without changing canonical files

Definition of done: filesystem and S3 adapters expose the same typed contract; conditional generic CRUD and idempotent retry; scoped bounded board query and deterministic paging; meaningful local emulator evidence; import/export is direct folder copy; isolated changes pass applicable checks before publication. No production deployment or persistent AWS access grants.
